title: MPS backend unavailable on macOS 13.7.4, error says 13.0+ required
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

```python
import torch
foo = torch.tensor([[1]])
foo = foo.to('mps')
```

results in
```console
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
RuntimeError: The MPS backend is supported on MacOS 13.0+.Current OS version can be queried using `sw_vers`
```
